FieldNotes.Comments: Site center located in an open retired farm field with heavy brush. Soil composition is compacted dark mud and clay. Battery LFP0835, voltage is 13.26. E-lines are covered by brush. Road located ~ 200m to the north. Airport located ~1km away to the NE direction. X- array with 0 rotation. Abundant wildlife activity in the area.
